<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Hryngar Bombardier](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3062)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Hryngar chemists have a knack for creating alchemical grenades. Their traditions often motivate them to constantly experiment and innovate, though the hostile nature of their environs tends to focus these innovations on weapons or other tools of war. Hryngar bombardiers eagerly steal notes and secrets from their underlings, pushing their students to cut corners to produce results while gleefully pillaging the credit and profits. For those hryngar bombardiers who find themselves pressed into combat service, each thrown grenade represents a new opportunity to observe the  suffering they inflict, before eagerly incorporating that data into their next experiment or innovation to create an even more terrible tool of torment.

<traits>
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Dwarf" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=584" />
<trait label="Hryngar" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=626" />
<trait label="Humanoid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=628" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 202

**Perception** +4; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Dwarven](/Languages.aspx?ID=3), [Sakvroth](/Languages.aspx?ID=118)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +6, [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) +6, [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) +6, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +6, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +4

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +1

**Dex** +3

**Cha** -1
</row>

**Alchemical Grenades** A hryngar bombardier carries 6 alchemical grenades that deal either acid, cold, or fire damage plus 1 [persistent damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) and 1 [splash](/Traits.aspx?ID=699) damage of the same type (typically two of each). The bombardier replenishes these grenades each day using easily collected materials.

**Items**
[Alchemist's Toolkit](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2702), [studded leather](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1774), [warhammer](/Equipment.aspx?ID=24)

</column>

**Will** +4 

+2 status to all saves vs. magic
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 20

</row>

**[Light Blindness](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=68)** 

</column>

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
warhammer +4 ([Shove](/Traits.aspx?ID=193)),
**Damage** 1d8+1 bludgeoning

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
alchemical grenade +8 ([range increment 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [Splash](/Traits.aspx?ID=150)),
**Damage** 1d6 acid, cold, or fire plus 1 [persistent damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) and 1 [splash](/Traits.aspx?ID=699) damage of the same type

**Occult Innate Spells** DC 17
- **Cantrips (1st)**
[Sigil](/Spells.aspx?ID=286)
- **2nd**
[Blood Vendetta](/Spells.aspx?ID=675), [Paranoia](/Spells.aspx?ID=214)

**Quick Bombardier** <actions string="Single Action" />  The hryngar bombardier draws an alchemical grenade with an Interact action and throws it as a ranged Strike.

</column>
